commands.name: spark-profiler-start
commands.label: Start profiler
commands.description: Starts the profiler in the default operation mode, optionally customised with flags such as --timeout, --thread, --alloc or --interval.

commands.name: spark-profiler-stop
commands.label: Stop profiler
commands.description: Stops the profiler and uploads the results to the viewer (use --comment <comment> or --save-to-file).

commands.name: spark-profiler-cancel
commands.label: Cancel profiler
commands.description: Cancels the running profiler without uploading the results.

commands.name: spark-profiler-open
commands.label: Open profiler viewer
commands.description: Opens the profiler viewer page without stopping the profiler.

commands.name: spark-profiler-info
commands.label: Profiler status
commands.description: Checks the current status of the profiler.

commands.name: spark-health
commands.label: Health report (live)
commands.description: Generates a health report and opens it in live dashboard mode, updating every 10 seconds.

commands.name: spark-health-upload
commands.label: Upload health report
commands.description: Uploads a static health report which does not automatically update.

commands.name: spark-health-show
commands.label: Show health report
commands.description: Prints a health report to the console, optionally including --memory and --network details.

commands.name: spark-ping
commands.label: Average ping
commands.description: Prints information about average ping round trip times across all players.

commands.name: spark-ping-player
commands.label: Player ping
commands.description: Prints a specific player's current ping round trip time.

commands.name: spark-tps
commands.label: TPS and CPU
commands.description: Prints information about the server's TPS (ticks per second) rate and CPU usage.

commands.name: spark-tickmonitor
commands.label: Toggle tick monitor
commands.description: Toggles the tick monitoring system, optionally with --threshold, --threshold-tick or --without-gc.

commands.name: spark-gc
commands.label: GC history
commands.description: Prints information about the server's garbage collection history.

commands.name: spark-gcmonitor
commands.label: Toggle GC monitor
commands.description: Toggles the garbage collection monitoring system on and off.

commands.name: spark-heapsummary
commands.label: Heap summary
commands.description: Generates a new memory (heap) dump summary and uploads it to the viewer.

commands.name: spark-heapdump
commands.label: Heap dump
commands.description: Generates a new heapdump (.hprof snapshot) file and saves it to the disk.

commands.name: spark-activity
commands.label: Recent activity
commands.description: Prints information about recent activity performed by spark.

commands.name: spark-activity-page
commands.label: Recent activity page
commands.description: Views a specific page of spark's recent activity log.
